title: LISD Names Its November Students of the Month
excerpt: Laredo Independent School District named eight students as its November Students of the Month, from Christen, Memorial, Lamar and Cigarroa middle schools and Martin, Nixon and Cigarroa high schools and Garcia Early College High School.
content:
Laredo Independent School District has named eight students as its November Students of the Month, the district announced Nov. 18.

The recipients are Thiago Flores of Christen Middle School; Athena Alvarado of Memorial Middle School; Sophia Grace Hinojosa of Lamar Middle School; Juan Manuel Nava of Cigarroa Middle School; Brianna Hernandez of Martin High School; Audrina Garcia of Nixon High School; Alfredo Armendariz of Cigarroa High School; and Andrea Rodriguez of Garcia Early College High School, according to the district.

The Student of the Month program is sponsored by Laredo Federal Credit Union, Clear Choice ER, Chick-Fil-A Marketplace on Bob Bullock and Laredo Orthodontics, the district said.

The district invites the community to get to know the Students of the Month better through the Student of the Month banner on the LISD website.

Sources: Laredo Independent School District, Nov. 18, 2026.
